mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 5-day forward returns is positive (r > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 220.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it indicates a tight labor market and constrained supply, leading to accelerating inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with supply constraints
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.0 AND INDPRO < 110.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE < 4.0), the economy is overheating, leading to a higher probability of central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for residential construction, signaling a robust economy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is negative (r < -0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 105.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 370000.0, it indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 900.0 AND RSAFS > 370000.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 and 20-day forward returns is negative (r < -0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
